title: Remove owned ticker listeners
why: An owned ticker callback that is never removed can retain objects and continue updating after its feature is disposed.
suggestion: Remove the same callback during feature or component disposal, or stop/destroy the owning application.
limitations: PixiJS v8 migration checks require an explicit version 8 pixi.js or @pixi dependency in package.json.
Ticker ownership is resolved only for direct receiver.ticker.add/remove calls and inline frame callbacks.
